drivingQuestion: When is the get written for one seized by kordiakos after ordering it?
outcomeNote: dispute recorded; developed in the next unit

segments.he: אָמַר: ״כִּתְבוּ גֵּט לְאִשְׁתִּי״, וַאֲחָזוֹ קוּרְדְּיָיקוֹס, וְחָזַר וְאָמַר: ״אַל תִּכְתְּבוּ״ – אֵין דְּבָרָיו הָאַחֲרוֹנִים כְּלוּם. אָמַר רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן לָקִישׁ: כּוֹתְבִין וְנוֹתְנִין גֵּט לְאַלְתַּר. וְרַבִּי יוֹחָנָן אָמַר: אֵין כּוֹתְבִין אֶלָּא לִכְשֶׁיִּשְׁתַּפֶּה.
segments.en: § The Gemara returns to its discussion of the halakhot mentioned in the mishna. The mishna teaches: If «he said: Write a bill of divorce for my wife,» when he was lucid, «and was» then «afflicted with» temporary «insanity and he retracted» his previous statement «and said: Do not write it, his latter statement» is considered to be «nothing,» i.e., it is not halakhically valid. The Gemara comments on this that «Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish says:» In that case the court «writes and gives the bill of divorce immediately,» because even though he is insane, the court does not wait for him to return to his senses. «And Rabbi Yoḥanan says:» They «write» this bill of divorce based on his instructions «only once he is healed» and returns to a sound state of mind.
